protocol.nuisance_definition: deterministic post-capture pixel/frame perturbations; physical demonstrator/body and official-eye capture unchanged
protocol.primary_rule: all safety/tracking; validity/action>=15 and >=4/action, >=2/domain; wins repaired controls>=12, >=3/action, >=2/domain; open>=15; adapter improves shuffled RMSE>=12, >=3/action, >=2/domain; distinct

limitations: Visual nuisances are deterministic digital post-capture perturbations, not physical camera hardware changes.
Exact supervised generated-action policy; no Series109 training or selection.
No biological vision, living fly, real muscles, FlyVis/FlyWire/connectome or mirror-neuron claim.
